messages.subject: Problems trying yo abalyze  GenomeWideSNP_6
parts:
Henrik

I was tring to identify CNV's using affy GenomeWideSNP_6 CEL files

If I try

cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6", tags="Full")
I get en arror message that the CDF file is not found.
However if I did
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6")
It can load the cdf file but fails on the next step which is.

gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf)
The error message I get is given below
Exception: Failed to retrieve genome information for this chip type:
GenomeWideSNP_6


Contents of my annotations file directory is given below

GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,na24,HB20080214.ufl
GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,na24,HB20080214.ugp

messages.author: bc1f4b339b21de43
messages.subject: RE: [aroma.affymetrix] Problems trying yo abalyze  GenomeWideSNP_6
parts:
Hi Joshy,

It looks to me like your "Full" cdf has a period (.) where a comma (,)
should be, ie it should be called "GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf".

Try that using tags = "Full".

Cheers,
Tim
